# Instructions for ui.apps.structure

This module contains structural package and repository definitions.

## Guidance
- Treat structural changes carefully.
- Keep changes minimal and explicit.
- Avoid broad restructuring unless explicitly requested.
- Explain impact on package layout, install structure, or repository structure.
- Do not modify structure merely for stylistic cleanup.

## Review focus
- package structure impact
- unintended install path changes
- backward compatibility risks
